body.name: Coefficient-level fourth-moment tensor
body.construction: For a finite multiset \(J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,L-1\}\), let \(\kappa_L(J)=0\) if \(|J|\) is odd and \(\kappa_L(J)=\mathbf 1\{\bigoplus_{j\in J}j=0\}(-1)^{\sum_{j\in J}\phi_L(j)}\) if \(|J|\) is even. For integers \(t_1,\ldots,t_4\), put \(b_p(t)=\lfloor(t+p)/L\rfloor\), \(j_p(t)=(t+p)\bmod L\), and \(\Theta_L(t_1,t_2,t_3,t_4)=L^{-1}\sum_{p=0}^{L-1}\prod_b\kappa_L(\{j_p(t_r):b_p(t_r)=b\})\).
